title: Synthetic platform migration readiness example
label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
execution_status: PRERECORDED — NOT A LIVE KAHRELUM RUN
question: Should a team commit now to an October 31 platform migration date?
scope: Illustrative scenario only. All entities, dates, counts, and statements below are invented; none describe a real customer or project.

evidence.statement: In this invented scenario, 8 of 10 planned service rehearsals have passed.
The two remaining rehearsals cover the highest-dependency services.
A rollback checklist exists, but no timed rollback rehearsal has been recorded.

inference: Passing most rehearsals is encouraging, but the unresolved highest-dependency cases and untested rollback leave material readiness uncertainty. The evidence supports continued preparation, not a firm date commitment.
uncertainty: The scenario provides no history showing how well rehearsal results predict production outcomes.
The scope, severity, and remediation time for the two remaining services are unspecified.
No independently verified rollback timing or recovery objective is provided.
counterargument: The team could still meet the date: eight rehearsals passed, the remaining failures may be routine, and the checklist may be sufficient if a rollback is rarely needed. The scenario contains no evidence that the remaining work will miss the deadline.

decision_gate.rule: Commit only after both high-dependency rehearsals pass against the frozen acceptance criteria and a timed rollback rehearsal meets the agreed recovery objective. Reassess if either gate fails.

record.summary: Current disposition: continue preparation; do not treat the date as cleared by this example.
record.preservation_note: This synthetic record is published unchanged as the example source for /demo and /api/v1/example. It is not a fresh execution, customer result, or empirical claim.
